main.description: Creates a workspace under a workspace account (its authority: the caller's own, or the account named by authority) with the grant its authority flow left, for the caller: the workspace, inbox and general channel spaces, the profile, the caller in their member lists, the caller's roster and admin records and the directory entry, as one journaled operation that a retry with the same operation id resumes. A caller other than the workspace account needs that account's approval of this workspace (a createWorkspace authority flow they started), which this operation uses up; without a grant or that approval it answers AuthorizationRequired.

authority.description: The workspace account: its DID is in every URI of the workspace. Omitted, the caller's own.

errors.name: AuthorizationRequired
errors.description: The operator holds no usable grant for the caller as an authority: start the authority flow with purpose reauthorize, then retry with the same operation id.

errors.name: WorkspaceExists
errors.description: A workspace of this name exists under the workspace account, or someone else is creating it there: it is joined through its admins, or its creator, not created again.

errors.name: Paused
errors.description: Workspace admin mutations are paused by the operator.

errors.name: Busy
errors.description: Another operation holds this authority's workspaces; retry with the same operation id.
